name: Tsukasa no ☆ Satisfaction ♪
original_name: ツカサの☆さてぃすふぁくしょん♪
source:
One year after events of Natsuiro ☆ Communication ♪. Main character is visited by Tsukasa suddenly while he prepares to summer with his lover Chinatsu. Tsukasa wants help with practice for the drama club. A long night of trouble begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
夏色☆交流事件一年后♪。主人公正准备与恋人千夏一起过夏天时，司突然来访。司需要戏剧社练习方面的帮助。漫长的麻烦之夜开始了。
